reason: Verified the token-semantics claim against the two cited snapshot files. Two of three sub-claims (input+output=total_tokens; reasoning as an output-token detail, not additive) match the snapshot content exactly. The 'fresh = input - read - write' formula conflicts with the actual non_cached_input definition in the semantics snapshot, which subtracts only cached_input_tokens (cache-read), not cache_write_input_tokens.

claims.claim: overall total = input_tokens + output_tokens (cache-read/cache-write are input-token details, not additive to total; reasoning is an output-token detail, not additive to total)
fresh (non-cached) input tokens = input_tokens - cached_input_tokens - cache_write_input_tokens
